accommodation: 35 suites, including Garden, Courtyard, Causeway, Portrush and Dunluce suites, plus twin and accessible options. The Stookan offers eight suites for exclusive group use.

confirmedFeatures: Restaurant and bar with tasting menus and sharing platters, Wine Vault, library, private dining, spa among ancient woodland, gym with personal trainers on request, alongside the fourth fairway of Royal Portrush Golf Club
overview: Dunluce Lodge, on Dunluce Road in Portrush, has 35 suites alongside the fourth fairway of Royal Portrush Golf Club, with views of the Causeway Coast. Dining uses locally sourced ingredients, with a wine and whiskey selection, and the spa sits among ancient woodland. The Dunluce Suites are the largest, with open-plan living.
surfTripFit: A luxury base for the Portrush and Causeway Coast beaches, including Whiterocks, a short distance away.
